newsitem.title: USA: Xyvision says CEO Conway stepping down.
newsitem.headline: Xyvision says CEO Conway stepping down.

text.p: Xyvision Inc said on Thursday that Chief Executive Thomas Conway has decided to step down.

The company did not give a reason for Conway's departure and did not name a successor. It did not immediately return a telephone call. Conway was hired in 1991 to help manage Xyvision's financial restructuring.
The company added that it completed a debt-to-equity conversion, significantly reducing its debt by over $7 million.
As part of an ongoing restructuring effort, Xyvision exchanged with investors six percent debentures and four percent promissory notes for common stock in the company.
Since the debenture conversions began in 1992, Xyvision has reduced the company's principal debt by over $19 million.
Xyvision did not disclose its current level of debt. It said it does not expect the matter to be finalized in the near future.
